title: Agreement of classical resolution classes and derived local classes
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism, $F$ an $O_X$-module, $q\ge0$, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, $V\subseteq Y$ open, $U=f^{-1}V$, and $R$ augmentation-preserving restricted-resolution data [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write $c$ for squareLocalResolutionComparison [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-local-models] and $\kappa:H^q(Rf_*F[0])\simeq R^qf_*F$ for schemeSingleCohomologyComparison of that node. Then the classical class map resolutionSectionClass followed by $(I.isoRightDerivedObj(f_*,q))^{-1}$ equals $c;\Theta^{Rf_*F[0]}_V;\Gamma(V,\kappa)$, where $\Theta$ is [lem-weil-pbc-derived-adjunction-top-edge]. The same formula holds if $U$ is any open supplied with an equality to $f^{-1}V$, transporting R.sections by that equality.

source.place: Tag 01E4, lemma-describe-higher-direct-images; Tag 01FB, remark-explain-arrow; Tags 0BKJ and 0D5X; normalization on the fixed K-injective representatives

proof.text: Eliminate the equality U=f⁻¹(V). The extended supplied injective resolution is K-injective. Apply the complex-level local-class computation with L=I.cocomplex and r given by the single-object comparison followed by the localized augmentation. Precompose by the three factors of the supplied restricted-resolution section comparison, and postcompose by evaluation of I.isoRightDerivedObj(f_*,q).inv.

Use the total/classical comparison on the supplied injective resolution. Expand isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex: its inverse is integer homology of mapExtendIso, then extendHomologyIso, then isoRightDerivedObj.inv. Evaluate on V. These are exactly the final factors of the preceding complex calculation. Both local computations use the same short-complex evaluation mapHomologyIso. Functoriality, identity transport of opens and associativity now give the displayed equality with squareLocalResolutionComparison.

theorem squareResolution_localClass {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : X.Modules) (q : ℕ) (V : Y.Opens) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U) :
    resolutionSectionClass R.resolution
        (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
        V (R.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun W ↦
          ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace W).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex) hU)) q ≫
      Hom.app (I.isoRightDerivedObj (pushforward f) q).inv V =
    (squareLocalResolutionComparison f F q V I U hU R).hom ≫
      (RingedSpace.topEdgeLocalClass Y.toRingedSpace (q : ℤ)
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F))).app (op V) ≫
      Hom.app (schemeSingleCohomologyComparison f F q).hom V
